title: FBI Role Index — Symbolic Roles, Archetypes & Created-Being Classes
rule: Search results are source-bounded. A match means a role appears in a particular project stratum, not that the person permanently 'is' that role.

roles.label: Dog
roles.definition: Boundary/tracking/pursuit role; can split toward Guardian Dog or Farm Dog.

matches.label: DIM / Dim Tooley
matches.note: Dog/serpent language appears in Tim's interpretation; later Dimmus fable depicts DIM as a dog. Not a permanent identity.

matches.label: TXT
matches.note: TXT's specialist room explicitly tracks Dog/Swamp symbolism and later comic-mythic reuse; documentary handle remains separate.

matches.label: Phil
matches.note: Phil is a Dog story character oriented toward the real Source; useful for healthy/transformative Dog grammar.

roles.label: Guardian Dog
roles.definition: Healthy Dog form: evidence discipline, proportional warning, protection of legitimate passage and a stopping condition.

matches.label: Phil
matches.note: Phil's Source-facing orientation helps define the good-Dog side of the project grammar.

roles.label: Farmer
roles.definition: Infrastructure/enclosure/classification/harvest role; shadow Farmer contrasts with regenerative Gardener.

matches.label: Josh Moon
matches.note: Project wordplay/relational analysis around Farm/Moon. Surname or platform role is not proof of literal or occult identity.

roles.label: Footstool
roles.definition: Lower/supporting project-topology state containing an unfound Door; not a statement of human worth.

matches.label: Dimmy Dog → Footstool
matches.note: A recovered story-family transition, not a documentary classification of DIM.

roles.label: Dweller
roles.definition: Morally neutral habitation state; the field inhabited determines the relation.

matches.label: Dwellers
matches.note: Collective positional class; not synonymous with Mud Dweller.

roles.label: Mud Dweller
roles.definition: One who has made unresolved Mud into a dwelling; explicitly reversible in mature project ecology.

matches.label: Rahu
matches.note: Lost-soul/Mud-Dweller growth story; scene-bound, developmental and reversible.

roles.label: Potato
roles.definition: Growth, resilience, nourishment, buried potential, sprouting; may be literal plant, identity, badge or created-being substrate.

matches.label: Literally
matches.note: Chronicle records an explicit playful 'I'm a Potato' self-identification.

matches.label: Matthew the Potato
matches.note: Creative being, distinct from real Matthew / @mtclassic3.

matches.label: Potatoes
matches.note: Collective Potato identity and created/literary forms.

roles.label: Tomato
roles.definition: Neighbor/counter-symbol with healthy, rotten, comic and satirical forms; not inherently an enemy caste.

matches.label: Rahu
matches.note: Self-proclaimed tomato-villain arc during the kitchen scene; temporary comic role.

matches.label: Brink / Real Brink Radio
matches.note: 'Tomato Apostle' preserved as an old-source alias only.

matches.label: Marty literary orbit
matches.note: Tomatoes describe a literary follower/counterculture collective in some scenes, not Marty or all real associates.

roles.label: Angel / Potato Angel
roles.definition: Created-being/messenger/guardian family with authored abilities where explicitly established.

matches.label: Potato Angels
matches.note: Wings, many eyes, light-work and dimensional/spiral movement belong to creative canon.

matches.label: Matthew the Potato
matches.note: Winged/many-eyed created Matthew; distinct from real @mtclassic3.

matches.label: Turbles
matches.note: Potato-shaped angelic species with jobs, hats, expressions and mixed grounded/winged forms.

roles.label: Guardian / Defender
roles.definition: Scene-function protecting a person, principle, boundary or legitimate passage.

matches.label: Matthew / MTClassic
matches.note: Moderation advice scene; does not make Matthew a Dog or Angel.

matches.label: Termite
matches.note: Guardian/Defender appears alongside Builder/Cultivator and Companion functions.

matches.label: Rage
matches.note: Guardian/Defender and Companion pattern in recovered Chronicle material.

roles.label: Builder / Cultivator
roles.definition: Makes rooms, food, tools, systems, art or conditions for growth.

matches.label: Mediomu007
matches.note: Room rearrangement supports Builder/Cultivator function without implying mystical ritual.

matches.label: Termite
matches.note: Cultivation is one of Termite's strongest cross-layer functions.
